fix(testing): every budgeted wait in a test is cut to what its case has left, so a slow run fails by the wait's name (brandon-menus-sjhy.r62) (#661)

* fix(testing): every budgeted wait in a test is cut to what its case has left, so a slow run fails by the wait's name (brandon-menus-sjhy.r62)

A real-daemon case spent a pool slot wait (20 s), readiness (12 s) and its
own waits inside one Jest timeout (30 s), each sized alone, so their sum
could pass it and Jest's anonymous timeout fired first. The test
environment now keeps the running hook's or test's deadline, computed as
jest-circus arms its timer, and every budgeted wait (the pool, readiness,
until, throughout, sendDaemonRequest) is bounded by the smaller of its own
budget and that time, less a margin derived from the longest step a wait
takes between deadline checks. The process tier's copies of the 30 s go.

* fix(testing): a wait's sub-steps share its one deadline, and every request failure names its bound (brandon-menus-sjhy.r62)

From the high review pass: the pool's start-time read and a request's
connect each spent time the wait had not charged; a cut render stated an
uncut deadline to the daemon; untilHeard ran past its case; a test whose
before-hook failed left its case's deadline set.

* fix(testing): untilHeard ends at a deadline, the pool reads its case after its own start time, and the rest of a case is a bound (brandon-menus-sjhy.r62)

From the medium review pass. A cut wait names the margin it keeps, and a
request whose deadline the daemon is told is sent under that same bound.

* fix(testing): a wait keeps its deadline on the case's clock, so faking the sandbox's clock freezes none (brandon-menus-sjhy.r62)

From the second high review pass. untilHeard keeps its 48 rounds, ended
early only by the case; a bound says what set it, so a pool wait the case
cut no longer blames the machine; render failures name their last bound.

## [1.208.3](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.208.2...v1.208.3) (2026-11-07)

### Bug Fixes

* **lanes:** a restart refuses a Claude Code that now holds another session, instead of resuming the old one over it (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.9ix) ([#660](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/660)) ([873a8e0](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/873a8e0e0be2d843b7d0b4c308831e2d20b5bde1))

fix(recording): a click's state crosses the recording ahead of the document it keyed, so a replay keeps the old run's value until the new one lands (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.09q)

A recording now writes a state line whenever the session's clicks' state moved
before a document; the replay restores it there instead of only at the next
draw. RECORDING_VERSION 6 -> 7.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(band): a switched-off band lane holds no follower process (candybar-animation-wbxz.w33)

The band mod stops its follow child on the daemon's SWITCHED_OFF answer
instead of keeping it alive to re-ask every 5s, and turning band (A) off
uninstalls the mod so sessions started afterwards never load it. An
uninstall of a mod that is not installed is the state off asks for, so it
is said rather than thrown.
